purpose: Document first-party local registry context and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: A public RoS INSPIRE WMS GetFeatureInfo request at a 101×101 pixel scale returned the full native MultiPolygon with INSPIRE id gb.ros.lr.SCT0009110317. Its geometry lies about 2.507 m from the unchanged WUP point and does not contain that point. A separate 1×1 sub-meter pixel centered at the exact WUP point returned zero features. One nearby polygon is retained as bounded local evidence; this is not a point hit or citywide coverage claim.
